summary.recommendation: PRIORITY 1: Fix SQL injection in SqliteUtil (legacy) by migrating all queries to parameterized style. PRIORITY 2: Implement stubbed-out ArticleRepository methods (markAsRead, toggleFavorite, etc.) or remove from interface. PRIORITY 3: Replace all console.log with structured logging. PRIORITY 4: Consolidate duplicate domain models (src/common/models.ts and src-electron/domain/models/Article.ts). PRIORITY 5: Extract long functions (>80 lines) using SRP decomposition. PRIORITY 6: Standardize on electronClient proxy across all stores.
